notes.title: Get your jetpack ready, take to the skies and remember Sky is just the beginning
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42595578/abed4132c877186b8662c586d5e8c1377e62af39.png[/img]

[h1]Get your jetpack ready, take to the skies and remember: Sky is just the beginning![/h1]

If after playing "[i]Star Wars Jedi: Survivor[/i]" you were left wanting to feel like a [i]Stormtrooper[/i] with Jetpack we bring you back [b]Windfolk: Sky is just the beginning[/b]. A third person shooter, but in the sky. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42595578/4a661fd23c73cfb24b9a270dbab862f12e0c8e65.png[/img]
You will be able to [b]explore every corner of Eurian[/b]: from a tropical environment with floating islands to an inhospitable desert with the remains of an ancient civilization. Help Esen protect his planet with different[b] skills, weapons and synergies that you can combine as you wish[/b] to fight in your own way. You'll have to shoot down moving targets so hopefully you'll have better aim than the [i]Stormtroopers[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42595578/90cd81a4389ea0c5bcd95fe59cb7a367d4c8b923.png[/img]
Take to the skies of this planet in two different ways: following the story with the [b]campaign mode[/b] or playing in different ways with the [b]arcade and its different game modes[/b]. 
The [b]soundtrack that adapts to the combat situations[/b] and has a different theme for each level of the game will make [b]flying, exploring and fighting an unforgettable experience[/b] for your ears.

[b]Featured content:[/b]
[list]
[*] A [b]fast-paced action[/b] in which the protagonist can [b]move freely[/b], in all directions of space, even up and down.
[*] [b]Very refined [b]flight mechanics[/b][/b].  
[*] [b]Different game modes[/b] that invite both to delve into the story and to enjoy only specific mechanics (racing, shooting ...).
[*] An immersive [b]soundtrack[/b], to make the experience of exploring the skies of Eurian more intense.
[*] Now available on [url=https://store.playstation.com/es-es/product/EP0811-CUSA17905_00-WINDFOLK00000000/]Playstation Store[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1966700/Windfolk_Sky_is_just_the_Beginning/]Steam[/url].
[/list]
Get ready to dive into a unique [b]experience with Windfolk: Sky is just the Beginning[/b]!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1966700/Windfolk_Sky_is_just_the_Beginning/
